UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_TcpTooltip: Join through the server's TCP tunnel, set up by its owner with Dont39 All-in-One. Helps when your network drops UDP.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_KcpTooltip: Join through the server's KCP tunnel, set up by its owner with Dont39 All-in-One. Recovers lost packets faster than TCP on a lossy network, at the cost of more bandwidth.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_PortTooltip: The port of the server's tunnel, from its owner. If the tunnel cannot be opened, the join stops and shows why; it does not fall back to UDP. Choose Off to join over UDP.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_Failed_NoAnswer:
No answer from the %1 tunnel at %2.
Check the tunnel port, or ask the server owner whether the tunnel is on.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_Failed_Refused:
No %1 tunnel at %2: the connection was refused.
Check the tunnel port, or ask the server owner whether the tunnel is on.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_Failed_NotTunne:
%2 is not a %1 tunnel of Dont39 All-in-One.
Check the tunnel port.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_Failed_Version:
The %1 tunnel at %2 speaks protocol version %3, this mod version %4.
The server and you need the same version of Dont39 All-in-One.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_Failed_ThisMach:
The server at %1 runs on this computer, where a tunnel cannot work.
Set Tunnel to Off for this server.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_Failed_LocalPor:
The tunnel cannot listen on 127.0.0.1:%1 (%2).
Close the program that uses this port and try again.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_Failed_Error:
The tunnel of Dont39 All-in-One stopped after an error (details in console.txt).
Set Tunnel to Off for this server to join over UDP.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_Failed_Inactive:
This server is set to join through a tunnel, but the tunnel of Dont39 All-in-One is off: %1
Set Tunnel to Off for this server to join over UDP.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_Failed_NoJava:
This server is set to join through a tunnel, but the Java part of Dont39 All-in-One is not loaded (allow it in ZombieBuddy).
Set Tunnel to Off for this server to join over UDP.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_Tunnel_Failed_Check: The tunnel check of Dont39 All-in-One failed (details in console.txt): %1
UI_Dont39AllInOne_NetworkStatus_ShowTool: In multiplayer, a signal icon in the bottom-left corner: the bars show your ping, a warning triangle shows packet loss. Hover it for details.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_NetworkStatus_Disabled: The network status stopped after an error (details in console.txt).
UI_Dont39AllInOne_NetworkStatus_Loss: Packet loss: %1 last second, %2 this session
UI_Dont39AllInOne_NetworkStatus_LossNotR: Packet loss: not reported for this connection
UI_Dont39AllInOne_NetworkStatus_TcpLoss: Loss is resent by TCP and shows up as latency
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed: Cannot join with the server's version of its Workshop items: %1
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed_Network:
Cannot download the server's Workshop items from %1:
%2
Ask the server owner whether its mod sync port is open.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed_Jar:
The server's version of %1 has other Java code (%2), which cannot be taken from the server while the game runs.
Ask the server owner to restart the server, which updates the item.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed_Refused:
%1 carries %2, which is never taken from the server.
Ask the server owner to restart the server, which updates the item.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed_Decline: The join stopped: you chose not to download the server's version of its Workshop items.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed_Dialog: The download dialog of Dont39 All-in-One failed (details in console.txt).
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed_Error: The mod sync of Dont39 All-in-One stopped after an error (details in console.txt).
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Failed_Inactiv: The server runs another version of a Workshop item, and the mod sync of Dont39 All-in-One is off: %1
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Preparing: Checking the server's version of its Workshop items...
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_Progress: Downloading the server's Workshop items: %1 / %2 files, %3 / %4
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_ConfirmText: Your copy of these Workshop items is another version than the one the server %1 runs. To join, the files that differ are downloaded from the server and kept for later joins. Your own copy stays as it is for single player and other servers.
UI_Dont39AllInOne_ModSync_DontAsk: Don't ask again for this server
